description: Elections Commission - Declare that T. U. A. Saththar was elected as the member of the B. Gettuwana of Kurunegala Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kurunegala Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as defined in Type 7.
